notes.title: Zero Caliber - The modding and PvP update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

I pressed it. I pressed the update button!!! Modding, cross-play PvP and tons of QoL stuff. Buckle up, we have a lot to go through!

[previewyoutube=RYubmniyybU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]MODDING[/h2]

Ever dreamt of building your own [b]single player/Co-op missions and PvP maps[/b]? Now you can build anything you want in Zero Caliber through mod.io (and Unreal Engine)! 
[b]Full guide here:[/b] [url=https://mod.io/g/zero-caliber/r]https://mod.io/g/zero-caliber/r[/url] + [b]on our Discord server:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/xrealgames]https://discord.gg/xrealgames[/url]
Worry not, you can also sit back (or stand up), and enjoy the work of other community members through the [b]ingame mod browser[/b]. You can find it near the dressing room in the lobby!  
[i]Hint: download modded maps through the mod browser, then launch them through the Solo- or Squad Operations panel.[/i]

We can't wait to see all the crazy maps and missions you'll come up with! In the meantime, [b]you can enjoy a few genre-defining classics[/b] in the mod browser already. ;) 

[h2]PVP | CROSS-PLAY[/h2]

PvP game modes are finally available, with cross-play enabled between the standalone and PCVR versions! You can find the 'Squad Operations' panel near the Armory entrance in the lobby.
We took extreme care to build platform-agnostic maps to avoid unbalanced matches between the two versions.
[i]Disclaimer: cross-play is enabled only for PvP in the base game, but modded Co-op maps could be cross-play if the creator chooses to build them so. [/i]

We’ve added [b]4[/b] new [b]PvP game modes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Deathmatch [i](up to 8 players)[/i]
[*] Team deathmatch [i](up to 4v4)[/i]
[*] Siege [i](up to 4v4)[/i]
[*] Gungame [i](up to 8 players)[/i]
[/list]
And [b]9[/b] new [b]PvP maps[/b]: 
[list]
[*] Bunkers
[*] Cargo
[*] Dust
[*] North Assault
[*] Swimming Pool
[*] Hangar
[*] Raid
[*] Wharf
[*] Train [i](prepare for some crazy fast action on Train!)[/i]
[/list]

[h2]QoL IMPROVEMENTS AND FIXES[/h2]

We've honestly lost count of how many fixes and improvements we squeezed into this update, but here are the ones worth mentioning: 

[h3]AI | MISSIONS[/h3]  

[list]
[*] Improved AI behaviour and pathfinding
[*] Improved combat behaviour on several maps
[*] Fixed and rearranged enemy spawn locations on several maps
[*] Fixed a rendering issue that affected enemy visuals
[*] Countless gameplay and combat improvements on the majority of missions
[*] Fixed a few POI related issues
[*] Improved collision settings on countless objects and environment elements
[*] Fixed quite a few checkpoints to avoid y'all getting stuck
[/list] 

[h3]GAMEPLAY | CONTROLS[/h3]

[list]
[*] Full body can now be turned on/off in settings
[*] Settings extended with customizable controller mapping [i](Touch controllers only)[/i]
[*] Audio input can now be customized (and reset) in the settings
[*] Fixed snap turning for Index controllers in left-handed mode
[*] Improved friend invite and friend request systems
[*] Improved benchmark scene
[*] Fixed melee holster position
[*] Improved controls all around
[*] Improved voice-chat stability and fixed a few connection issues
[*] Fixed an issue with shotgun shells
[*] Sock 18 and M249 rebalance
[*] BAR handling improvements
[*] Fixed quite a few skin system related issues
[*] Fixed missing and faulty sound effects
[*] Fixed a few controller binding related issues
[/list]

[h3]VISUALS | PERFORMANCE[/h3]

[list]
[*] Overhauled lighting on several maps
[*] Improved color balance and contrast ratios throughout the game
[*] Improved foliage all around
[*] Fixed several LOD related issues
[*] Fixed countless assets popping out of thin air
[*] Fixed shadows for several weapons
[*] Improved UI 
[*] Fixed quite a few hand poses on smaller items
[*] Improved loading times between missions/multiplayer sessions
[*] Optimized several maps for smoother gameplay
[/list]

[h3]SERVERS[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a brand new [b]dedicated Aussie server[/b] for those down under
[*] Improved server stability 
[*] Enabled cross-play between standalone and PCVR versions [i](PvP and mod only)[/i]
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]

No update is perfect, and and this is no exception. :( 

[h3]CUSTOM STEAMVR BINDINGS[/h3] 

Anyone who used custom SteamVR controller bindings for Zero Cal will be reverted to default - this is necessary to fix an issue that would result in players getting stuck with faulty/broken controls. If you still experience broken controls, dig into Zero Cal's file system and delete the 'input.ini' file. 
[i]Join our Discord if you need help![/i] 

[h3]VIRTUAL DESKTOP[/h3]

Yeah, so.. this is a bit awkward. We broke something last-minute and as a result, the game has a high chance of crashing when launched through Virtual Desktop. 
[b]BUT![/b]
You should be able to switch to an [b]experimental public beta build[/b], aptly named "VirtualDesktopHotfix". We've made a few last-last-minute changes that might fix the crashing issue. This build is 100% compatible with the rest, meaning cross-play works all the same. We didn't have time to test the whole build, but in theory nothing else changed so it should work. 

We're really sorry for this.. we could've postponed the update once again while we properly fix it, but I don't think I would've survived another delay. :') 

-------------

Alrighty, I think that's all for now. This is a huge update with a lot of changes and additions, we'll be on the lookout for your feedback. [b]Please channel ALL your suggestions, ideas and feedback into this dedicated thread: [/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/877200/discussions/0/3811784760599130247/ 

Or hop on our [url=https://discord.gg/xrealgames]Discord[/url] and let us know directly in the appropriate channels. 

Have fun y'all, happy building and see you on the virtual battlefield! o7 
Cheers, 
[i]-Dan & the whole XREAL team[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber - the GRAND update is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

The day has come... [b]Zero Caliber just got infinitely better[/b]! The weapon handling, the vastly improved AI, new weapons, new melee feature, dedicated servers for Co-op, built-in voice chat and a TON more - you HAVE to try it to believe it! 

[b]The GRAND update is now LIVE![/b]

[previewyoutube=98LOc9zWmMI;full][/previewyoutube]

The game has changed a lot. A LOT. We strongly believe that the gameplay got 120% better, 140 smoother and 200% more fun! 
We've done all this to prepare the game for the upcoming [b]mod support[/b] update - soon anyone will be able to make single player/Co-op missions and PvP maps for our beloved shooter! [i](Yes, PvP is still on the table!)[/i]

Now, given how many things got changed, fixed, finetuned and added, [b]you'll have a lot to go through and get accustomed to[/b] (including new control schemes with the added jumping and crouching features). [i]If you've played Zero Cal before this update, we strongly recommend you to replay the whole game as you'll encounter new and smarter enemies, better combat scenarios and revamped gameplay all around![/i]

[b]Dedicated servers[/b] and [b]built-in voice chat[/b] are making a debut as well. We've got quite a few reports of peeps not being able to connect to each others' games in the past - now with dedicated servers, we hope this is fixed for good. We might need to adjust server locations or their capacities as we go, so if you experience any connection issues, please let us know!

Speaking of which... [b]FEEDBACK[/b]. We need it. Our QA team tested the hell out of this build, but with so many changes there are bound to be bugs we had missed. 
[b]To make our life easier and feedback more organized, please put ALL your feedback into this pinned thread:[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/app/877200/discussions/0/3720567164487211951/
The same goes for progress - we made sure there would be no progress loss, but if there is, please let us know in the same thread!

And finally, here's the full changelog. Well, most of it anyway, if you notice anything in the game that's not in here, please let us know in the comments. o7

[h2]GRAND UPDATE CHANGELOG[/h2]

[h3]WEAPONS | ATTACHMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 11 new weapons [i](Sig SG552, Beretta CX4 Storm, Famas, M249 (LMG), Barrett M82A1, M590 Shockwave, Thompson submachine gun, M1 Garand, Luger, Mp40, Ppsh-41)[/i]
[*] Added 7 new melee weapons [i](Tactical knife, Bayonet that can be equipped as attachment, Machete, Small axe, Crowbar, Baseball bat & Baton)[/i] - they're available scattered around on all maps
[*] Added a new melee holster where your tactical knife will hang out at all times
[*] Pump action shotguns can now be pumped by one hand
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/6ae632d6763fd1c271a6ecc5368d2095a2f106cb.jpg[/img]

[h3]AI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved enemy behaviour: they're more sharp and they react/switch targets much faster
[*] Improved cover usage: enemies can now shoot from different sides and angles when behind a cover
[*] Enhanced decision making - AIs now prioritize targets based on 'danger level' [i](weapons used, distance etc,)[/i]
[*] More realistic head movement: enemies now look at their target
[*] Improved existing- and added new NPC animations
[*] Enemies now get to cover much faster by sprinting
[*] Enemies are actively looking for targets, they patrol and move tactical in combat
[*] Enemies now have a melee ability (kicking and smashing), if you get too close to them
[*] Improved aiming (more accurate and quicker)
[*] Added range dependent attack modes
[/list]

[h3]MULTIPLAYER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Switched from P2P connections to dedicated servers for Co-op [i](better sync and perf)[/i]
[*] Added native voice chat with a muting option
[*] Fixed countless connection issues
[*] Vastly improved netcode and stability
[/list]

[h3]GAMEPLAY | CONTROLS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a melee feature [i](including throwing, stabbing & cutting)[/i]
[*] Vastly improved weapon handling and more intuitive weapon, item and interactables highlight system
[*] Polished body IK that can now be turned off optionally [i](leaving you with hands only)[/i]
[*] Improved climbing mechanics [i](it's much more polished now)[/i]
[*] Improved 'step up' to the top of climbable objects
[*] Added single handed “akimbo” reload for pistols
[*] Vastly improved magazine grabbing 
[*] Added a much more intuitive weapon-, item- and interactables highlight system
[*] Added a height measurement system [i](auto calibration & sitting mode)[/i]
[*] Added holster position calibration
[*] Added controller offset calibration
[*] Improved weapon balance
[*] Improved left hand mode
[*] Locomotion side selection added to settings menu
[/list]

[h3]CAMPAIGN MISSIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked and improved combat on all missions - 200% more fun!
[*] Overhauled gameplay all around
[*] New objectives on several missions
[*] Rebalanced difficulties
[*] Added more VR interactions to make the game more immersive and fun
[/list]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fpjzCz54lDa5tJ4CM9/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h3]GRAPHICS | UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked and greatly improved environment on several maps
[*] Improved VFX effects
[*] Improved hand model - byebye balloon hands!
[*] Added a better, more precise self-hit indicator system
[*] Added a region selector popup window to make selecting the appropriate server region easier 
[*] Replaced the world map with a new mission selector in the lobby
[/list]

[h3]SOUND[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved bullet flyby sounds
[*] Improved bullet impact sounds
[*] Added more ambient sounds on open maps
[*] Improved headshot audio feedback
[*] Added different, satisfying sound effects for headshot hits and kills
[/list]

[h3]MISC[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed and improved so many things we've honestly lost count
[*] Vastly improved performance all around
[/list]

[h3]POSSIBLE BUGS [/h3]
[list]
[*] Index controller misalignment: if you see any peculiar behaviour, please delete the 'Options' [i](and only the Options!)[/i] save file in C:\Users\[username]\AppData\Local\ZeroCaliber\Saved\SaveGames
[*] Height issue: if your height is off, please recalibrate your height in the settings
[*] A few enemies might get stuck on the 1st Forest mission - just blast them from a distance if it happens
[*] POIs might be missing on the 2nd Forest mission
[*] Enemies might get too afraid and might not come out to play at the end of 'Lockup'
[/list]

---

We could've called the update 'Zero Caliber 2.0', but since we want to include mod support AND PvP before thinking about pressing the full release button (1.0) we went with 'GRAND' instead. 
We hope you'll enjoy this version of ZC - we're really curious about what you think, so please don't hesitate to send your feedback our way either in the comment section below, in the dedicated feedback thread linked above or directly on [url=https://discord.gg/xrealgames]Discord [/url]!

notes.title: Road to THE update - Zero Caliber devblog I.
notes.notes:
[b]Hey folks, [/b]

As you might be aware, we took it upon ourselves to get Zero Caliber in shape a while back [i](quite a while back actually)[/i].
I've talked about it in past devblog posts, hell, even sounded like a broken record at times [i](and I still do I know)[/i], but I'm gonna repeat myself anyway: 

We're currently working on the dreaded code merge to bring all code optimization and most of the new features from the game's standalone version back to PC. 
As it turned out the merge is a one-man show, meaning that the task can't be parallelized [i](is that even a word?)[/i] - only one person can work on it at the same time. This greatly increases the time that has to be dedicated to the process. Merging something, making sure it clicks with the rest of the code, testing, fixing, testing again then moving onto the next thing.

Current estimates show that the merge itself will be concluded in 1.5-2 months, then our GD and GFX teams are going to fix up the maps/weapons and then we'll be good to go! 🤞 

As we're getting closer and closer to THE update, we thought it'd be a good idea to go through ALL the stuff that is going to change to refresh our enthusiasm. ;)

One of the not-so-perfect parts of the current version is the hand model and the weapon handling. The new weapon priority system and the new hand model will make everything so much better! Different as night day I tell ya.

notes.title: Zero Caliber Update: Player customization, massive graphics overhaul & more!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone! [/b]


It’s been a couple of months since our last update. 
During these months 2020 went bonkers, which understandably affected our development speed as well. 
Despite all the circumstances though, we have been [b]extremely busy[/b] behind the scenes! 

Where to begin… 

The [b]two major changes[/b] happened under the hood: [b]game engine update[/b] to a newer version, and ditching deferred rendering in favor of [b]forward rendering[/b]. 
Both of these changes were necessary to make the game more stable, more optimized. The first thing you will notice is the much [b]sharper imagery[/b] (perks of forward rendering). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/d01f57bf89ec4d805c83b6e088a65f74a47945b5.jpg[/img]


We had to convert all the environments and light settings to fit in the forward rendering pipeline - and while we were at it, we [b]spiced up the atmosphere[/b] across all maps.
The results are… [b]stunning[/b]! Better frames, better, sharper visuals, smoother gameplay. What’s not to like? :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/82b941289ede6150f1ad63adfe866eb2ebe39a4b.png[/img]


These changes took a lot of time to make and test (especially in a remote working environment) and didn’t leave room for new content. Except for… the promised [b]player customization[/b]!

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/fSFWyLm9F4rheicGIK/giphy.gif [/img]

[*] Improved default Index controller bindings - [b]ejecting mags is now the 'A' button[/b]
[*] Reduced player speed for gameplay balance- and motion sickness reasons
[*] Player height is now adjustable between 150-210 cm
[/list]

[h3]MULTIPLAYER [/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved sync[/b] between the host and clients to reduce lag, thus resulting in a smoother and more stable Co-op gameplay 
[*] Fixed the sync of crouching and prone stances
[*] Fixed an issue that caused extended magazines to be replaced with default magazines in Co-op sessions
[*] Being able to pull off other players’ attachments is disabled (except for magazines)
[*] Fixed various issues preventing the player from using force pull or grabbing weapons
[*] Fixed multiple issues caused by respawning and reviving other players
[*] Various fixes for client side issues and performance
[*] Fixed intro subtitles being displayed multiple times in Co-op
[*] Fixed scaling enemy numbers for different player counts
[*] After a mission’s end screen, the game doesn’t throw players to another map automatically after 5 minutes
[*] The server list and the number of players on the multiplayer screen now refreshes every time upon joining, not only after checkpoints as before
[/list]

[h3]SOUNDS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sound is now forced on Oculus headsets
[*] More immersive bullet impact sounds
[*] Altered soundscape when low on HP
[/list]

[h3]GFX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Customizable quality settings for better scalability - We reworked the graphics settings menu. There are now [b]a ton of options[/b] to fine tune graphics settings. Choose the combination best suited for your system’s capabilities! 
[i]The game still performs a benchmark test upon launching for the first time after the update, and sets the graphics accordingly. This is on point most of the time. [/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/63bf7e2e2e7cf4424b3b5502b43deed3107f1d30.jpg[/img]


[*] Switched to forward rendering from the previously used deferred rendering. This results in a sharper imagery and better performance all-around
[*] Improved lighting and reworked atmosphere on all maps
[*] Improved GPU performance thanks to forward rendering
[*] Tweaked temporal anti-aliasing for sharper rendering
[*] Introduced five new graphic quality presets to easily set up the game’s performance
[*] New highlight system for interactable items/objects

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/eNAkK1AQL3lRVZTODQ/giphy.gif [/img]


[*] Materials and lights are converted to forward rendering on all maps
[*] More accurate light maps
[*] Optimized textures
[*] Several minor asset fixes
[/list]

…and hundreds of other minor fixes. 

[h3]KNOWN ISSUES[/h3]
[list]
[*] A few players might run into these issues - they are known and will be fixed in a later update. Sorry for any inconvenience they might cause!
[*] Weapon lighting inconsistencies in the armory
[*] In the 'Tutorial' the game might display buttons necessary to perform certain actions on the opposite controller
[*] The initial benchmark might not recognize hardware correctly, thus setting graphics quality below the PC's capability
[*] Noisy cricket effect: the Kriss Vector and/or its attachments might become tiny when attaching-removing them rapidly.
[*] Blurry environment textures
[*] Loss of force pull/interaction ability when removing and reinserting other players' magazines
[/list]

---

[h3]“But XREAL, where is the PvP?”[/h3]

Good question, glad you asked! 
We don’t feel comfortable enough to release it yet. All the major changes introduced in this update are a necessary step towards it, but PvP itself isn’t 100% ready. 
[b]It is coming very soon though![/b] We’re planning some sort of beta testing in the coming weeks. 
Joining our Discord server is the best way to get notified about it. ;)
-> https://discord.gg/JyK2gVh

After making sure this update doesn’t break the game, we’re going to keep tinkering with [b]dedicated servers[/b] to prevent major issues when PvP finally drops.  

[h3]WORKSHOP SUPPORT[/h3]

YES! We've been wanting to introduce modding and workshop support for ages, and now it looks like it is happening! 
No ETA yet, as we're still in the midst of finding the best way to implement it, but it IS coming. 

---

Thank you for sticking with us until the end, and thank you for your patience! We are really sorry for the delay and hope that the update can compensate for it. 

As it is with every major change, things might not be perfect 100% of the time - if you encounter anything strange (and it's not listed under the 'KNOWN ISSUES' section), please report them in our Bug reports section. 
[i]We see every topic even if we don't respond immediately.[/i]


We'll soon be back with our plans for the next major update  - until then, make sure to follow us on Social Media to catch all the latest news!

notes.title: Zero Caliber Update - New map, new weapons, optimization & much much more!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone! [/b]

This update is huge. HUGE. Probably the biggest one in the game's history. 

We've overhauled the 'Tutorial' for new players [i](replaying it is recommended even for seasoned Zero Caliber veterans)[/i], we've added the [b]first part of the next story chapter[/b], 'Canyon' and [b]three new weapons[/b] (MK18, FN SCAR, USP). Shotguns recieved proper reload mechanics and we've introduced a new, experimental reload for pistols. As a result, dual wielding them became one of the most badass things in the game! Oh, and we’ve also added [b]distance-dependent weapon damage[/b]. And [b]virtual gunstock[/b]. And a [b]new ragdoll system[/b] for the AI. And we've increased the amount of XP earned per mission. 
Missing [b]Touch controller bindings[/b] got fixed and we've revisited the [b]Index controller handling[/b] - hopefully it feels much better now!

[b]BUT...[/b] an even bigger part of this update can be found under the hood - [b]performance optimization![/b]
Our programmers have been knee-deep in the game's core code to optimize it almost from scratch. We're hoping that this will improve the performance across all kinds of configurations. 

We've been testing the game until the last second, but since the code optimization is massive, it's almost guaranteed that players will run into small issues here and there. 
[b]If you encounter anything unusual, please head over to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/877200/discussions/1/]Bugreport section[/url]! [/b]

[b]ATTENTION: unfortunately one of the negative results of the code optimization is the loss of player equipment and saved loadouts. [i]The progress and unlocked items however should stay the same![/i][/b]

And now.. here's the full list of changes, additions and improvements:

[h2]MAPS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tutorial rework: we've overhauled the whole tutorial both visually and functionally in order to explain the game better for inexperienced players. [i]If you're a seasoned veteran, you can launch it from the world map.[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/27666b181fdfa9c69a981fd129c6871012c1f78a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/8706afe8006a20c656ea560bed14cae35eafe03d.jpg[/img]

[*] New story mission: Canyon. It is the first part of the new campaign destination. [i]Can be played after 'Hail'.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/ecdabea6ea34ff60a3681d1d2800ab7b69ee00a7.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]WEAPONS | ATTACHMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] MK18 with 9 different skins
[*] FN SCAR with 6 different skins
[*] USP pistol with 9 different skins
[*] New attachments: MK18 suppressors, 2 angled grips, holo sight. [i]New content is marked in the armory.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/bfe2d02b4473f5654fc4ede3a2b98b24b98ddedc.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Damage falloff[/b]: the amount of damage done by a weapon is now distance-dependent. 
[*] [b]Pump-action[/b] for all shotguns. [i]SPAS has the option for semi-auto firemode.[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Y0z3eYaOly6lUusJks/giphy.gif [/img]

[*] Unique shotgun spread for all shotguns
[*] Shotguns now take shells one-by-one from clips. [i]If your shotgun is only missing one shell, the other 4 shells will stay in the clip and the clip doesn’t disappear.[/i]
[*] Reworked weapon physics - more realistic behavior when weapon is not held in hands
[*] All holo sights have new, adjustable brightness/color options
[*] Underbarrel grip removal now works the same way it does with other attachments IF autogrip is OFF: hover over the grip, press trigger and pull it away. [i]If autogrip is ON, functionality remains the same - when your hand grips onto the weapon automatically, press trigger and pull away to remove the grip[/i]
[/list]

[h2]GAMEPLAY | AI[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Virtual gunstock[/b] option added [i](look for it in the settings!)[/i]: 'ON' mode is for all weapons, 'REALISTIC' mode applies only to weapons which already have a stock as part of the weapon body [i](e.g. AWP, AKM, AK47)[/i] or weapons which have a stock equipped and opened out [i](e.g G36C+stock attached)[/i]
[*] Experimental, but badass [b]dual pistol reload[/b]: when both mags are ejected (by pressing the mag release button), lower your hand to your ammo pouch, then press the slider back button. BAMM. - [i]This new feature might work inconsistently in Co-op for now.[/i]

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/lnmzuAzrunKPMWu6D2/giphy.gif [/img]

[*] Improved recoil for every weapon and attachment
[*] [b]Increased XP for levels - less grinding[/b]
[*] Weapon colliders and physics materials are improved to give a smoother gameplay experience when weapons interact with the environment
[*] New ragdoll system: caliber- and shooting distance-dependent AI death reactions 
[*] AI soldiers are now able to walk through dead AI bodies
[/list]

[h2]MULTIPLAYER[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized network code for smoother Co-op gameplay. [i]It's still not perfect, but we're getting there![/i]
[*] Map selector at the end of each map - players are now able to continue the game without quitting to the lobby by voting on the next mission.
[/list]

[h2]PLAYER | CONTROL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Haptic feedback (rumbling) added when gripping weapons and grabbing mags from the belt
[*] [b]Oculus Quest support FIXED[/b] with improved Touch controls
[*] [b]Fixed an Oculus Rift S bug[/b] where players couldn’t do anything at first start
[*] [b]Improved Index Controller[/b] controls: grabbing functionality with the controller has been revisited and improved. You will have to squeeze a little more to grab something [i](no more sucking up items when you just wanted to rest your fingers)[/i], removed the tiny delay when releasing items [i](smoother grenade throws)[/i].
[*] Default Grip Option is set to Hold-To-Grab for Touch and Index Controllers, Toggle-Grip for Vive Wands by default. [i]Can be changed in the settings.[/i]
[*] Updated object handling for Touch controllers: mags, grenades and attachments can only be grabbed and picked up with the trigger, while the grip button is for grabbing weapons and bigger, non-weapon related objects.
[*] Controller [b]dead zone default value increased[/b] from 0.05 to 0.11 to avoid phantom movement
[/list]

[h2]GFX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimization and more optimization
[/list]

[h2]SOUND[/h2]
[list]
[*] Super immersive environmental sounds
[*] Redesigned indoor sounds
[*] Updated weapon sounds
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where after grabbing an attachment from one hand to another, knock-off functionality would be lost
[*] Fixed an issue where after dropping an attachment and quickly grabbing it would make attaching it to the weapon impossible
[*] Fixed bouncing weapons - weapons now have more realistic physics
[*] Menu pointer fixed when holding weapons with both hands
[*] Vive: can’t take weapons out of other players holsters anymore
[*] VIVE and Index Controller: fixed an issue where quickly dropping and grabbing a weapon by its slider caused the weapon to drop to the ground
[*] Sock 17\18c left-hand grab position fixed
[*] Fixed an issue where weapons sometimes disappeared after respawning or the player spawned with other players' equipment
[*] Fixed an issue where the green outline stayed on objects
[*] And endless more small bugfixes...
[/list]

[h2]HONORABLE MENTIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] PvP - unfortunately we had to delay it. Still needs polishing - you can expect some form of beta testing in Q1 2020! 
[*] Dedicated servers - same as with PvP, we have to iron out some technical issues.
[/list] 

---

Phew... Quite a list! 
As you can see, we went a little overboard with the amount of content and new features. Again. :) We wanted to cram everything into this update so you can have an amazing experience during the Holiday season. 
As a result, small issues might pop up here and there - please report them via the Steam forums, e-mail, Discord or homing pigeons. We'll check everything after a short Winter break. 

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCj9kaf9i-FT-RkUPPLTh-dg]Youtube[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/XREALGamesVR]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/xrealgames]Twitter[/url] to recieve all the latest news about the PvP and our games in general. 
[b]Thank you for an incredible 2019, 2020 will be even more exciting! Happy Holidays! 
[/b]
[i]-XREAL Games Team-[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber devblog - 1 year anniversary and the upcoming update
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone, [/b]

Our beloved shooter will soon celebrate its official [b]1-year anniversary[/b]!
Zero Caliber was released in Early Access on 9th November, 2018, but it was born a little bit earlier - the first playable builds came into existence around this time 1 year ago.. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/6cfd0596ac853818d53f6e6939a89dd2ecbc30d1.jpg[/img]

To celebrate this, the upcoming update and the upcoming PvP’s beta - which is getting closer and closer by the day (probably December) - we’ve decided to have a 1-week-long sale for the first time since the game's launch. 
[i]Pro tip: might be a good time to get into the game and practice so you can jump into PvP as a veteran when the time comes. ;)[/i]

I’ve also put together a short list with all the goodies that are coming in the next update - the main new feature will be [b]player customization![/b]
Detailed patch notes are coming alongside the update, which is [b][strike]scheduled to go live around the 1st of October[/strike][/b] - re-scheduled to go live later (hopefully around 11 Oct. at the latest) due to optimization issues with the skin system.

[i]Images shown below showcase WiP states and are subject to change.[/i]

[h1]PLAYER CUSTOMIZATION | RANK ICONS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/c71d6c7cf15051775b4751dbc7fa85f03d61e03e.jpg[/img]

After introducing weapon skins, we’ve started to experiment with [b]custom player skins[/b] and [b]accessories[/b]. The first batch of custom items will make it into the update: a mix of serious military equipment and goofy items just for the fun of it. :)
[i]The items/skins will be unlockable through the progression system, or can be found hidden throughout all maps.[/i] 

We’ve also reworked the rank names and icons - because who doesn’t want to show off his/her hard earned rank?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/3ccb0d36691acc86f0d6f83b939bd2df6278f441.jpg[/img]

[h1]WEAPONS | RECOIL REBALANCE[/h1]

A lot of you requested a recoil update on all weapons: it is happening! 
Every weapon got [b]unique recoil behaviours[/b] in order to balance them out better - [i]this balance will be vital in PvP as well[/i].
The Uzi, P90 and the BAR got double mags (which are now fixed and work correctly), while the M4A1, Python and P90 got new weapon skins. 

[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]

There’s now a [b]confirmation window on the death screen[/b] before returning to the lobby - hopefully this will stop accidental exits from a session.
We’ve also added an [b]option to have the mic always on[/b] - this will be useful for VR Arcades, and for regular players as well who doesn’t like turning the radio on every time they want to tell something. 

[h1]RELOAD AND CONTROL IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

We’ve improved the way of interacting with attachments [i](more on this in the final patch notes)[/i] and made it easier to remember to reload weapons: if hints are enabled, the sliders will be [b]highlighted[/b] if there is no shell chambered - a helpful hint to remind you to reload your weapon.
Sprinting with heavier weapons like snipers and the BAR is now possible again.

[h1]SOUNDS[/h1]

We’ve updated the audio engine to its latest version which means improved soundscapes, dynamic movement sounds and all kinds of improvements all around.

---

Besides the things mentioned above, numerous fixes and improvements are also coming in the update. 
The update after this one will probably focus on bugfixes and polish, but you can expect new content as well, plus a new, updated tutorial map. 
PvP alongside dedicated servers are in the works, we’ll soon tune in with more information about the planned beta and everything you need to know.

After one year we still have a lot to do, we’re still full of plans and ideas! We’ll see how well we can manage our time. :) 
Thank you all for the continuous support and patience! 

[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber Content Update - New map, new weapon, weapon skins, loadout storing system, sharper graphics & countless more goodies!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We have two, very very busy months behind us. As a result, we can proudly present [b]Zero Caliber’s biggest, most packed content update[/b] since its EA release last year! 
We’ve brought you a[b] new map - Lockup[/b], a [b]new weapon - Glock 18[/b], the much-awaited [b]loadout storing system[/b], unlockable [b]weapon skins[/b], sharper graphics and a lot, lot more! 
[i]Really, when i say a lot more, i mean [b]A LOT[/b] more. [/i]

[b]This update is a HUGE one, please read through all the patchnotes below to see the full picture.[/b] 
It’s impossible to summarize all the new content and improvements in a few words. 

[h1]MAPS[/h1]
[list]
[*] New mission: [b]Lockup[/b]. [i]The Tlalokii have overtaken a maximum security prison. You're tasked with the covert mission of recovering sensitive prisoner lists.[/i]

[img] https://i.imgur.com/3ApkABh.jpg [/img]

[i]NOTE: You can find a basketball court mid-mission with functioning basketballs. Because even soldiers have to relax mid-combat.[/i] 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/h8mV7eVmzU1PCFKODm/giphy.gif [/img]

[/list]

[h1]WEAPON SKINS | REWORKED LOBBY
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Extended Armory[/b]: with the amount of weapons and skins we have, it was time to extend our armory with new weapon racks, and a shooting range [i](which is still WiP)[/i]

[img] https://i.imgur.com/ZK6FF1E.jpg [/img]

[*] The new weapon racks contain [b]all the available weapons[/b], their [b]skins[/b], [b]all the attachments[/b] and their [b]skins [/b]and [b]all types of magazines[/b]. And their skins. Yes. All of them.
[i]NOTE: You can choose which weapon skin you prefer and all the corresponding items will use that skin.[/i]
[*] [b]Unlocking weapon skins[/b]: each skin has a [b]rank requirement[/b] you have to reach. There are also [b]hidden mystery skins throughout all maps[/b] [i](if treasure hunting is your thing - yarr!)[/i]; they can only be unlocked by [b]finding them[/b]. 
[/list]

[h1]NEW LOADOUT STORING SYSTEM
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Store your favourite loadouts![/b]
You now have access to[b] 3 life-size mannequins[/b] to store your favourite loadouts on.
You can manually suit up your doppelgängers with your favourite setups, [b]OR [/b]you can just press the appropriate buttons (either to store or to equip) to make the process faster.

[i]Store your gear, and they'll be waiting for you next time you launch the game.[/i]

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/ZErERfhMCRykINabVM/giphy.gif [/img]
[/list] 

[h1]WEAPONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New weapon: the Glock 18[/b], a legendary fully-automatic pistol. 
[i]Did i mention it also has a drum mag? Brrrrt.[/i]

[img] https://i.imgur.com/24GIZ5z.jpg [/img]

[*] Tactical shield level-up: when using [b]a pistol and shield combo[/b], you can reload one-handed for that extra badass feeling!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TdcE8LnVRKq0bDKe7h/giphy.gif [/img]

[*] [b]Burst fire mode[/b] added for the following weapons: G36 [i](double shot)[/i], Glock 18 [i](triple shot)[/i] and the KRISS Vector [i](double shot)[/i]
[*] Most weapons have [b]multiple new types of magazines[/b]: extended, double, drum, etc.
[*] All magazines have skinned versions and you can combine them with different weapon skins
[*] Grenades now have [b]indicator trails[/b] when thrown, with lights and sound effect
[*] [b]Shotgun clips[/b] can be used for easier reload: load 5 shells in at a time, then keep taking clips out of your ammo pouch instead of individual shells.
[i]NOTE: Why have shotguns without proper reload mechanics? Good question! 
Pumpable shotguns are finally coming in the next update! [/i]
[*] The last 15 weapons you’ve grabbed won’t disappear within a ~32m radius 
[*] Revolver ejects bullets/casings correctly
[*] Turret release by distance fixed
[*] Stocks dynamically open or close depending on which state is closer [i](instead of always opening unless completely closed)[/i]
[*] G36 stock now works as intended
[/list]

[h1]ATTACHMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Attention! The way of removing attachments has changed![/b] 
Press and hold the trigger, then pull the attachment away [i](no need to use button combinations anymore)[/i]. 

[img] https://i.imgur.com/H9Cz5sk.jpg [/img]

A short trigger press (no holding!) without pulling your hand away will change the modes on the attachment if applicable. 
[u]WITH UNDER BARREL GRIPS[/u]: Little bit different, you have to secondary grab the weapon (grip) - then press the trigger and pull the attachment away to remove it. 

[img] https://i.imgur.com/lommC9J.jpg [/img]

[i]NOTE: Knocking off an attachment with another one still works![/i]
[*] Smart attachment interaction when pressing the corresponding button - action performed in this order: 
1. Release slider IF backed
2. Activate side attachment IF there is one on the weapon AND the slider isn’t backed
3. Activate scope IF the slider isn’t backed AND there is no side attachment
[*] Attachment optimization resulting in much better performance
[*] Silencers can be removed from pistols
[*] Flash suppressor now works as intended
[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY | AI
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Smarter AI behavior[/b]: the enemy will change states, run in and out of cover, run away or charge you depending on the situation around them 
[i]NOTE: Friendly AI will get a rework soon![/i]
[*] AI spawn optimization resulting in better performance
[*] Loading screen added
[/list]

[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]
[list]
[*] Holster improvement: can’t remove other players’ holstered weapons. 
[i]No more stealing. :’([/i] 
[*] Reviving other players isn’t instant anymore, it has a small (1 sec) cooldown.
[*] Force pull sync improved
[*] Improved weapon spawning to hand
[/list]
	
[h1]PLAYER | CONTROL IMPROVEMENTS
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trigger/grip interaction: we've separated what the trigger and grip buttons can do:
Trigger: ammo and attachment interaction
Grip: weapon grabbing
[*] [b]Reloading while crouching[/b]: it is now easier to take out ammo from the belt while crouching [i](ammo pouch collider is around the player’s knees when crouching) [/i]

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/h3oKMalixN0g5YdDLO/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] Wrist and lower arm positioning and rotations are reworked
[i]NOTE: It is much better than before, but still WiP.[/i]
[*] UI laser beam improved: it is now independent from weapon length
[*] Completely [b]reworked Comfort Mode[/b] setting for players prone to motion sickness - it is much more pleasant now. Also we now have three intensity settings under Settings>Game
[*] Comfort mode setup added to Lobby
[*] Player doesn’t glitch anymore when pressing full locomotion immediately after spawning
[*] Various force pull bug fixes
[*] Menu and pointer now supports main hand setting for left handed players

[i]NOTE: Index controllers are not supported officially. It's coming in the next update![/i]
[/list]

[h1]GFX[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sharpened image to reduce overall blurriness - MUCH more sharp graphics 

[img] https://i.imgur.com/BqHBzoB.jpg [/img]

[*] No more head- and armless body after player death
[*] POIs are now fading when the player looks towards them - less obstructing
[*] Menu UI scaled down
[*] Impact decals are now attached to dynamic objects
[*] In the menu, after pressing Exit to Desktop, Cancel button now works
[*] New map has an experimental GFX feature (on VR platform): lens flares [i](bless Michael Bay!)[/i]
[*] ‘Retaliation’ map got the 'american-night' filter: instead of pitch-black, it has a nice blue ambient atmosphere
[*] Overall post processing FX improvements
[/list] 

[h1]SFX[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated gun sounds
[*] Burst weapon tail sound fixed, sound echoes after every burst even if the player doesn’t let go of the trigger
[/list]

----

Phew, what a list! 
As you can see, we went a little overboard with all the things we wanted to pack into this update. It took a little longer than we wanted to, but we made it! - well, almost made it. 
We’re aware this update isn’t completely bug free. [b]Currently these are the bugs we know about, they will be fixed in a hotfix coming in the next few days.[/b]
[list]
[*] PSO scope disappears from the weapon rack under the Dragunov
[*] [strike]Co-op: if a squadmate finds a mystery skin then the whole squad recieves the skin[/strike]
[*] Reloading weapons which were taken off the mannequins: several magazines get stuck at the belt
[*] End of 'Lockup' chopper scene shakes the camera unnecessarily
[*] 'Lockup' checkpoints: respawning at checkpoints takes a bit too long because of the map's loading time
[*] Incorrect impact decals are displayed on walls when shot at from some weapons
[*] Picking up random weapons and grabbing them in the secondary hand position makes the hand invisible in some cases
[/list]

If you encounter any other bugs, please head over to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/877200/discussions/1/]Bugreports[/url] section and report them - [i]we read ALL the reports, even if we don't answer immediately[/i]. 

We're eagerly waiting for your feedback about this update - please share your thoughts with us on either of the platforms listed in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/877200/discussions/2/1681441347870749327/]Contact Us[/url] topic. 

---

That's all for now, go and have fun! :)
And thank you for the continuous support and patience, it's really appreciated!

[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber Update - M9 Beretta, BAR, AI improvements, OST, fixes & more!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone! [/b]

The next update is here! 
[i]We’re sorry for the delay, we had to fix some unforeseen bugs before being able to release it. [/i]

We’ve added [b]2 new weapons[/b], the M9 Beretta for pistol fans, and the BAR for light machine gun enthusiasts. Both of them have unique, skinned variants laying around on several maps.

[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber news - mini devblog and the next update's release date
notes.notes:
[b]Hey all, [/b]

We hope you guys are all wondering when and what will be the next step for Zero Caliber en route to its full release.
We know we still have a long road ahead of us, but with all the great feedback and suggestions we could gather from the community already, our team is now working harder than ever to make the game just like you all want it to be!

The [b]next update[/b] will be a [b]major one[/b], scheduled [b]around 15th March[/b]. 

[b]What can you expect from this update? [/b]

[i]Disclaimer: all footage seen below are from the testing phase and don't represent their release state.[/i]

[h1]First part of a massive AI overhaul[/h1]

Our AI [i]-both enemy and teammate-[/i] isn’t perfect. We know that. Our team has been working very hard to bring new life to AI behaviour and animations and we are eager to show you its result!
Although still far from final, their behaviour will be much more lifelike: they received proper animations, be it regular movement, reloading, cover finding or aiming. 
That, combined with a reworked aiming system means that they will move much more smoothly, and will behave more like a human instead of their current choppy nature. 
We still need a lot of internal testing and bugfixing, but you can expect to fight a much more intelligent enemy starting from the next update! 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/dYB3oibfFkTUDnAZmc/giphy.gif [/img]

[h1]Improved and fine tuned movement system to avoid possible motion sickness[/h1]

Zero Caliber is one of the more intense titles out there when it comes to movement. This means that people prone to VR induced motion sickness might feel a little dizzy after longer play sessions. 
We’ve already implemented a so called ‘Comfort mode’ to counter this (found in the options menu), as well as started to even out the terrain to avoid frequent and sudden up and down movements. 
In the next update, you’ll see a few changes, namely: 
[list]
[*] Slower base speed, slower strafing, slower backward speed
[*] Slower speed when crouching
[*] Player can only run when not aiming (depending on weapon type)
[*] Run can be automatically or by-input activated (can be set in the options menu)
[/list]

[i]We are hoping that this change will further help in countering motion sickness, and will also give a more realistic movement feel.[/i]

[h1]‘Timber’ rework[/h1]

The game’s first campaign map, ‘Timber’ is currently very demanding performance wise. People with weaker PCs might experience FPS drops due to the huge gameplay area and all the details that can be seen at the same time. 
We’ve decided to change the map’s layout. The mission’s length and aesthetics will remain the same, but the overall performance will be much more optimized across all the mission. 

[h1]Initial setup guide[/h1]

The game has a lot of options, which can all be found in the settings menu. To make things easier for players, we’ve implemented a setup guide, which will pop at the first start of the game (and can be skipped for experienced players). 
This quick setup guide will help players to select the optimal graphical settings, preferred locomotion type (head or hand oriented, left or right hand, snap or smooth turn) and other important settings.
All these settings can be adjusted later in the options menu, but inexperienced players will have an easier time setting up the game in order to achieve the best experience possible.

[h1]Better hand animations[/h1]

We’ve also improved the player’s hand animations. Pulling the trigger and reloading the guns will feel much more natural!

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/3q4Qqii8tYkbSR6wgd/giphy.gif [/img]

[h1]Steyr AUG[/h1]

Our weapon selection will be expanded with yet another community favourite: the [b]Steyr AUG[/b] bullpup [b]assault rifle[/b]. 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/55rS2RtlQVZA5hm6Ns/giphy.gif [/img]


Based on your feedback, and the fact that we want to polish Zero Caliber as much as possible, we’ve decided to concentrate more on core mechanics and gameplay improvements for this update. 
This of course doesn’t mean we’ll leave you without content updates! We’re also already working on two new singleplayer/coop maps that will be released a bit later. 
The list of things we’re working on doesn’t stop here! 
Our PvP mode is in the works too, we’re expecting a [b]beta-ready state next month[/b]! Are you guys excited? We surely are and will count on all your feedback in this stage more than ever!
[i]We’ll keep you guys posted about future updates as we progress.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/13e7500b096ee89b7d95bbd9273ec726b70c94d5.jpg[/img]

If you have any questions/request/advice, feel free to contact us here on Steam, on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/xrealgames]r/xrealgames[/url], on our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/R5ZUsjB]Discord[/url] or our social media channels any time!

[b]Thank you guys for your continuous support, and again, as we make the game for you it is essential to keep every feedback coming![/b]

[i]Daniel
XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.notes:
[b] Hey guys and gals! [/b]

In the past few months, you could've read different release dates and confusing deadlines surrounding Zero Caliber VR. 

[b] Let's make a clean breast about it all! [/b] 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/9S5h5wvPxsp60p9xjg/giphy.gif [/img]

TL;DR: 
[b] Public demo: [/b] to be released on [b] 25th October, 2018 [/b] <available for free until the release> 
[b] EA release: [/b] dropping on [b] 9th November, 2018 [/b]
[i] Wishlist Zero Caliber VR to get notified about announcements and important news! [/i]

[h1] [i] "But Devs, why all the delays?" [/i] [/h1] 

Good question, glad you've asked. :)

During the [i] Closed Alpha test [/i] we've realized that there are many Oculus Rift and Windows Mixed Reality players eagerly waiting for Zero Caliber VR. 
Their numbers far exceeded our first estimations!
[b] That is why we've decided to develop the control support for all these VR systems before releasing any public version of the game. No one should be left out! [/b]
Another reason for the delay is all the feedback our wonderful Alpha Testers sent our way. We've been busy fine-tuning the game and eliminating bugs  based on our community's feedback. We can't thank them enough!

We've also decided to update the game's engine to the latest version before going public. Such an update takes extra time as we have to make sure our game runs flawlessly on the new version as well. 

As we're still a small Indie Studio with limited resources, we ask for a little more patience. Don't worry, you don't have to wait for too long! We're only 1 month away from the public demo, then 2 weeks later comes the release. It's all for a better experience for you guys, we promise! :) 

[i] "A delayed game is eventually good, but a rushed game is forever bad."
/Shigeru Miyamoto, Nintendo/ [/i]

https://discord.gg/eH8Bt24 [/b]

notes.title: Zero Caliber VR demo version/Alpha Test
notes.notes:
[h1] Dear Zero Caliber fans/enthusiasts! [/h1]

[i] [TL;DR at the end] [/i]

We know you are all eagerly waiting for the public demo version of Zero Caliber VR which was originally scheduled to be released on 5 August. 
Learning from our previous mistakes, we have decided to push the demo’s release date back a bit. [b] We don’t want to leave you without Zero Caliber though! Anyone who is interested in testing Zero Caliber can participate in the closed Alpha test to be held in August (starting around the 10th). [/b]
You can sign up for the Closed Alpha test via our Discord: https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB. You’ll find all the details there! 
The fully polished public demo version will be released in [b] early September. [/b] 

[h1] But… why? [/h1]

The reason we’ve decided to push back the demo a bit is that we feel like Zero Caliber isn’t as polished as we’d like it to be. 
When we released our first title, A-Tech Cybernetic, it was way too early in its development. Even though A-Tech evolved immensely since then and we’re getting very positive reviews to this day, the game itself - due to it being released too early - lost a lot of initial interest and visibility. We don’t want to make the same mistake again, players will receive a fully polished demo version of Zero Caliber so everyone can experience it in all its glory as we originally intended. 

[h1] What does this mean? [/h1]

It means that by the time the public demo is released in September, it will be a fully enjoyable and mostly bug-free experience thanks to all the feedback and test results we’ll hopefully get from our Alpha testers. :) 
Don't forget to put Zero Caliber VR on your wishlist so you can catch all the announcements and updates!

[b] TL;DR: Zero Caliber VR public demo release date pushed back to September, Closed Alpha instead in August. Apply on Discord: https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB [/b]

Thank you for understanding, we hope we'll see all of you in our Alpha! ;)
Stay tuned for a fun gameplay teaser coming soon!
